lines.text: A large crowd gathers from town after town, and Jesus tells a parable about a farmer sowing seed.
Seed on the path is trampled and eaten by birds, seed on rocky ground withers for lack of sunlight, thorns choke other seed, and good soil yields a hundredfold.
The disciples ask what the parable means, and Jesus says the seed is the word of God.
The devil takes the word from the path people, rocky-ground people have no root, thorns choke others, and good-soil people persevere.
Jesus says no one lights a lamp and hides it under a basket, and He tells them to pay attention to how they listen.
